info.title: Imazeo backend
info.description: Customer APIs use /v1; admin APIs use /admin/v1. Media APIs are project-scoped and accept a customer bearer token or a server-side X-API-Key. JSON responses use success/data/meta envelopes; media responses return bytes. No payment provider is active. Health is operational and unversioned.

message.example: If eligible, an email will be sent.

content.description: Text to encode. Also subject to the configured UTF-8 byte limit (default 2048 bytes).

size.description: Output edge in pixels; configured limits may be lower.

errorCorrection.description: Error correction level: low, medium, quartile, high.

content.description: Text to encode (a string preserves leading zeroes). code128: 1–80 characters; code39: 1–48 uppercase letters/digits or - . space $ / + %. ean13: 12/13 digits; ean8: 7/8; upca: 11/12; itf14: 13/14. Omit the check digit to compute it; supplied check digits must be valid.

height.description: Bar height in millimetres before scaling.

includeText.description: Display human-readable content below the bars.

data.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (without a data-URL prefix).

width.description: Page width in PDF points at scale 1 (72 points per inch).

height.description: Page height in PDF points at scale 1 (72 points per inch).

spec.description: Normalized options; omitted dimensions/effects are null. Rotation is normalized to 0–270 degrees.

fit.description: Default cover when width and height are provided, otherwise inside. cover/contain/fill require both dimensions.

stripMetadata.description: Metadata is always stripped. Only true is accepted.

negate.description: Invert colour channels when true; alpha is preserved unchanged.

blur.description: Gaussian blur sigma. Omit to skip blur.

sharpen.description: Sharpen sigma. Omit to skip sharpen.

brightness.description: Modulate brightness multiplier (1 = unchanged). Omit to leave brightness alone.

saturation.description: Modulate saturation multiplier (1 = unchanged). Omit to leave saturation alone.

hue.description: Hue rotation in degrees. Omit to leave hue alone.

extend.description: Padding in pixels after effects. Each side 0–MAX_OUTPUT_DIMENSION; totals capped; at least one side > 0.

background.description: Hex colour for contain letterbox, extend padding, and JPEG flatten. Default #ffffff matches legacy behaviour.

position.description: Resize focal position (mainly for cover). Default center matches legacy Sharp centre.

imageId.description: Exactly one of imageId or url is required.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) image URL; each request revalidates and fetches it.

maxOutputBytes.description: Output byte ceiling reserved before work; actual bytes are committed.

fit.description: Default cover when width and height are provided, otherwise inside. cover/contain/fill require both dimensions.

stripMetadata.description: Metadata is always stripped. Only true is accepted.

negate.description: Invert colour channels when true; alpha is preserved unchanged.

blur.description: Gaussian blur sigma. Omit to skip blur.

sharpen.description: Sharpen sigma. Omit to skip sharpen.

brightness.description: Modulate brightness multiplier (1 = unchanged). Omit to leave brightness alone.

saturation.description: Modulate saturation multiplier (1 = unchanged). Omit to leave saturation alone.

hue.description: Hue rotation in degrees. Omit to leave hue alone.

trim.description: Trim near-background borders after orientation. `true` uses threshold 10; or `{ threshold: 1–100 }`.

extend.description: Padding in pixels after effects. Each side 0–MAX_OUTPUT_DIMENSION; totals capped; at least one side > 0.

background.description: Hex colour for contain letterbox, extend padding, and JPEG flatten. Default #ffffff matches legacy behaviour.

position.description: Resize focal position (mainly for cover). Default center matches legacy Sharp centre.
